url_reachability.describes: the path where there was nothing to fetch. The reference input contains no URLs, and the suite blocks outbound connections, so this figure excludes the request that is the whole cost of the detector. Its budget is a deadline it enforces on itself rather than a measurement, because it depends on a network the library does not control

reference_input.description: Romanian prose with no entities in it, so this measures the cost of looking rather than the cost of finding

reading_this: Every score carries its sample size in `n`. A detector that is not built has `metrics: null` rather than stale figures. `caveats` is not optional reading: it is where a score of 1.000 on four examples says so.
